about_the_game:
Please note this game is in active development and things are subject to change with feedback from players and as the game develops. This is a solo-developed game, and is made with care. Thank you for checking out the demo and I hope you enjoy it!

Cavernreach is a first-person exploration adventure that plunges you into the depths of mostly uncharted cave system—and into the mystery of a group of missing cavers who vanished within.

There are no enemies. No combat. Just the quiet weight of the underground pressing in around you… and the fading trail of those who came before.

Your goal: follow the traces of the missing cavers, piece together what happened, and explore the depths of the cave system.

Explore, Survive, Discover

You’ll navigate a massive, interconnected cave system filled with winding tunnels, towering caverns, vertical shafts, and submerged chambers. Every area is handcrafted with care to evoke awe, tension, and wonder.

There’s no map. No objective markers. Just your flashlight, your instincts, and your determination to discover the cave system - and the missing cavers fate.

Gameplay Features

• Atmospheric, Immersive Exploration
Traverse a seamless world of shadow and stone, where each twist of the cave tells its own story.

• Resource Management
Monitor your oxygen, battery life, and health—running out of any could mean the end of your journey. Upgrade your gear by selling rare mineral resources discovered deep underground.

• Climbing, Crawling, Diving
Use ropes to descend, crawl through tight squeezes, and scuba dive through flooded tunnels as you push further into the unknown.

• No Combat, No Enemies
This isn’t about fighting monsters—it’s about enduring nature itself. The voice on the other end of the radio is your only companion.

• Narrative Mystery
Uncover remnants of the past, beautiful areas deep underground, and the truth about what happened to the lost cavers.

• Solo-Developed Project
Cavernreach is being built from the ground up by a solo developer with a love for adventure, atmosphere, and the thrill of true exploration.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 @ 2.4GHz+ / Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX series graphics card / Radeon equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 @ 3.8GHz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX series graphics card / Radeon equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Explore a vast, handcrafted cave system in this atmospheric first-person adventure. Manage your gear, gather resources, and follow the trail of lost amateur cavers deep beneath the surface. No combat—just isolation, survival, and discovery.
